name: Nishi-Taishido
tagline: Shibuya in 14 minutes and Shinjuku in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 38 minutes to Otemachi, 24 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 30.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 25.8 m to 34.9 m, a difference of 9.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 21 clinics and 22 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 樹のはなクリニック, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 歯科, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Setagaya Line.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Tokyu Setagaya Line. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Sangen-Jaya is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Nishi-Taishido is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Taishido. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Nishi-Taishido.

neighbours.lead: Wakabayashi is ahead on quiet, but Nishi-Taishido is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Taishido. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nishi-Taishido. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 lower.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 世田谷通り (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 16 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Setagaya Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
